metadata.name: pritok
metadata.description: PRITOK: corporate actions for tokenized bonds

accounts.name: authority
docs: The holder, or the registrar acting for the holder.

accounts.name: claim
docs: Same seeds as a wallet claim: a payout goes either to the wallet or to the bank, once.

accounts.name: agent_payment
docs: Paying agent's account: the registrar's associated account for the payment token.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Payment vault: holds funded, not yet claimed obligations; only the program moves money out.

accounts.name: owner_payment
docs: The holder's own associated account for the payment token: the only place the money can go.

accounts.name: coupon_claim
docs: otherwise left untouched so the coupon can still be claimed later.

accounts.name: owner_payment
docs: The holder's own associated account for the payment token.

errors.name: PaymentMintNotAllowed
errors.msg: Payment mint is not on the operator's allowlist

errors.name: PaymentMintExtensionNotAllowed
errors.msg: Payment mint has an extension that changes transfer amounts or routing

errors.name: TransfersClosed
errors.msg: Transfers are closed after the maturity record date

errors.name: NotCanonicalAta
errors.msg: Token account is not the holder's canonical associated token account

errors.name: WrongActionKind
errors.msg: Wrong action kind for this instruction

errors.name: BankSettlement
errors.msg: Action is settled through the bank path

errors.name: CannotDefault
errors.msg: Action cannot be marked as defaulted

errors.name: VaultBelowReserve
errors.msg: Payment vault holds less than reserved obligations

errors.name: NotHolderOrOperator
errors.msg: Only the holder or the registrar can request a bank payout

errors.name: NotBankRequest
errors.msg: Payout is not awaiting bank confirmation

errors.name: PriceAboveLimit
errors.msg: Total price exceeds the buyer's limit

errors.name: OperatorRedemptionUnavailable
errors.msg: This issue was created without operator redemption

fields.name: factor_bps
docs: Face-value factor after all declared partial redemptions (10 000 = 100%).
Each event carries the factor it is calculated from in `factor_bps_applied`.

fields.name: issued_units
docs: Bonds outstanding at every record date; fixed when subscription closes.

fields.name: supply
docs: Bonds not yet burned.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Funded and not yet claimed onchain obligations held in the payment vault.

fields.name: events
docs: Sorted by `record_ts` (ties keep insertion order).

types.name: Claim
docs: Receipt for one holder's payout on one event; its existence prevents double payment.

types.name: Event
docs: One corporate-action event. `action_id` is a stable name (used in claim PDAs);
the event's index in `Bond::events` is its chronological position.

fields.name: factor_bps_applied
docs: Face-value factor this event is calculated from (10 000 = 100%).

fields.name: synced_upto
docs: Number of leading events whose record-date balance is frozen in `bal_at`.

fields.name: bal_at
docs: Balance at the record date of the event at the same chronological position.

types.name: TradeSettled
docs: Settlement record in the transaction log: price, accrued interest and total.
